mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission matrix fact eliminates the specification of allowed cells, causing LeastPrivilege to fail when Alloy finds a model where permissions differ from the intended matrix.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermMatrixViolation { Customer -> DecideApplication in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing uniqueness on timestamps allows duplicate timestamps for events in the same application, breaking the append-only invariant that AppendOnly checks.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateTimestamps { some disj ae1, ae2: ApplicationEvent | ae1.application = ae2.application and ae1.occurredAt = ae2.occurredAt }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the audit completeness constraint allows applications to change status without corresponding audit entries, which is exactly what AuditCompleteness prevents.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAuditEntry { some app: LoanApplication | app.status = Approved and no ae: ApplicationEvent | ae.application = app and ae.newStatus = Approved }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the constraint that only the assigned officer can decide allows a non-assigned officer to make a decision, violating the FR-013 invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonAssignedDecider { some dec: Decision | dec.decidedBy != dec.application.assignedOfficer }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the constraint allows customers to have multiple in-flight applications, directly violating the FR-008 requirement.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MultipleInFlight { some cust: User | some disj app1, app2: LoanApplication | cust.role = Customer and cust = app1.customer and cust = app2.customer and (app1.status = Submitted or app1.status = UnderReview) and (app2.status = Submitted or app2.status = UnderReview) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing assignment constraints allows applications to be decided without being claimed (assigned), violating the workflow where claim must precede decision.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAssignment { some app: LoanApplication | (app.status = Approved or app.status = Rejected) and no app.assignedOfficer }
